sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 9298—Establishment of the Berryessa Snow Mountain National Monument, July 10, 2015

review.note: Proclamation 9298, 80 FR 41975, signed 2015-07-10; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President.

designationHistory.indexText: Boundary Enlargement of the Berryessa Snow Mountain National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 10745—Boundary Enlargement of the Berryessa Snow Mountain National Monument, May 02, 2024

review.note: Proclamation 10745, 89 FR 39531, signed 2024-05-02; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Antiquities Act reservation of additional land; kept as a modification (a proclamation adding land is a designation under the Act), not treated as a mere boundary revision.
